messages.content: Create a SHORT image prompt in ENGLISH (max 45 words). PREMIUM EDITORIAL CARTOON (Brazilian charge, Wired style). Visual metaphor about AI agents and automation. Characters INTERACTING with friendly AI robots — teamwork, handshake, pair programming. Bold flat vibrant colors (electric blue, coral, purple), clean background. NOT photorealistic, NOT childish, NO text, NO letters. Centered, LinkedIn feed ready. Return ONLY the prompt.
